Company between May 1961 and Ju1y 1962.
lt was detertnined that the central co れ t で 01 工 od was bound in its shroud at a position

ln accordance with the evidence. The most striking and unexpected phenomenon

duced a water hammer with pressures up to 10 , 000 psi, which, in turn, caused
